caption: Distribution of samples (%) across varying values of sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity.
model_annotation: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of samples across different levels of ambiguity standard deviation and maximum ambiguity. The chart is composed of six slices, arranged in a donut format. These slices are colored blue, light blue, and a pale pink. The largest slice, colored blue, represents "Std: 0.0" and occupies approximately 38.0% of the chart. Following this is "Std: 0.47", also colored blue, with an estimated 14.2%. A light blue slice labeled "Std: 0.82" represents 7.0%, while another light blue slice labeled "Std: 0.94" occupies 7.0% of the donut. The remaining slices are pale pink; one labeled "Max: 1" occupying approximately 5.0% and the other "Max: 2" with 39.0%. Percentage labels are displayed within each slice. A legend is present, specifying the color assignments for each category. The light blue slices appear to be ordered from smallest to largest proportion.
